comparison.objective: Verify a GFCI by pressing TEST and then RESET in the required order; candidate breaks and collects HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered button actuation and state verification versus precision bimanual tool alignment, impulse delivery, force regulation, and debris recovery.
comparison.success_condition: TEST trips the outlet before RESET restores it; reverse order cannot score. Candidate requires four physical fractures and an intact, fragment-free shell.
comparison.reason: Sequence-sensitive switch operation does not test fracture mechanics, tool stabilization, or fragment containment. Button travel thresholds are not provided.
